introduction.text: The Archivio Museo Storico di Fiume is a museum and archive in Rome that preserves documents and artifacts related to the city of Fiume and the Italian diaspora from Dalmatia.

history.description: On 12 July 1972 the Minister of Education Oscar Luigi Scalfaro issued a decree granting the Archivio Museo Storico di Fiume the status of an archive of "exceptional historical interest" and placing it under state protection.
In 1987 the Soprintendenza Archivistica per il Lazio placed the archive under the protection provided by Article 38 of D.P.R. 30.91963, n. 1409, recognising its significant historical value.
The 2004 law 92/2004, which established the Giorno del Ricordo, officially recognised the Archivio Museo Storico di Fiume as a cultural asset of the history of Fiume and the Giulian‑Dalmatian exodus.

design.description: The museum occupies a basement room of 250 m² that includes a sacrario memorialising the fallen in Dalmatia and a collection of documents on migration from Adriatic centres. The second floor houses an archive and library covering another 250 m², a meeting room for 30 people, computer facilities, and a director’s office.

art.description: The museum displays works by Fiuman artists spanning from the 1700s to the contemporary period, illustrating the artistic heritage of the city.
